changelog:
Initial release of cs-verify skill.

- Verify factual claims against live data sources with structured verdicts and confidence scores.
- Supports claim categories for faster and specialized verification (financial, entity, geo, factcheck).
- Provides a trending claims endpoint showing the top 100 queried claims in the last 24 hours.
- Free tier available (25 queries/day, no auth); paid tier supports unlimited queries via USDC.
- Includes unique referral system for earning credits on agent queries.
summary: Verify factual claims against live data sources. Returns structured verdicts with confidence scores.
